title: Meal kit delivery
summary: Pre-portioned ingredients and recipes delivered weekly.
whyTempting: Removes planning and shopping; strong initial demand.
whyItFails: High churn. Customers try discounted boxes and leave. Expensive logistics. Cold chain and packaging eat margins. Customer acquisition cost. Discounts drive signups that don't stick.
whatWouldChange: Supermarkets and existing delivery networks absorb the logistics cost.

attempts.notes: Prepared-meal delivery in San Francisco, Seattle and New York; closed abruptly in January 2019.
IPO in 2017; paying customers fell 24% in one quarter in 2018 and it lost over 80% of its market value within a year.

attempts.outcome: Shut down abruptly as funding dried up

reasons.detail: High churn: Customers try discounted boxes and leave.
Expensive logistics: Cold chain and packaging eat margins.
Customer acquisition cost: Discounts drive signups that don't stick.
